title: Every dropdown in the panel opens when you click it
goal: User 2026-09-28: 'NONE of the dropdowns work. They are all broken.' Every video panel dropdown is VideoKit.Dropdown (VideoKitControls.swift:283-312): a drawn SelectFace with a SwiftUI Menu (borderlessButton, label Text(value) in Color.clear) overlaid at .opacity(0.011). Leading theory, UNPROVEN: a real pointer click never reaches that near-transparent menu (or only its tiny invisible label's area), while walks pass because they open menus through accessibility (press by name) rather than clicking at a point, so every dropdown can be dead to a person while every walk is green. Reproduce with a REAL click first.
notes: Filed from the intake window. The caption style task (every-caption-style-control-changes-the-captions) depends on this.
acceptance: Reproduced first: a walk at Next defaults CLICKS (pointer click at the control's centre, and near each end, not an accessibility press) every dropdown in the Captions, Time, Transition, Sound and Properties sections and records whether the menu opened; also by hand in the probe; the report names the cause
Every dropdown opens on a click anywhere on its face, shows its choices, and choosing one changes the value; keyboard (space/return when focused) opens it too

The dropdown is one design-system component (docs/design/mocks/pages comp-select or the matching comp page) built so its face IS the hit target, not a transparent overlay; it matches the mock's look in every state

Walk rule: a walk may not open a menu, dropdown or button by accessibility press in a test meant to prove it works for a person; the harness gains a pointer-click-at-control step and the walks for these sections use it (a test enforces this for panel controls)
A test fails if any control in Sources/Photonz uses an opacity below 0.05 as a hit target
Every other drawn control that uses the same overlay trick (search for .opacity(0.0 and Color.clear labels) is listed and fixed or filed

log.note: Reproduced with a pointer click (new panelMenu "at" step, posted mouse down/up at the point on the drawn face, the probe in front) at Next defaults: Show dropdown face 148x24, the menu button laid over it 37x16 at 1% opacity; clicks at centre, start and end all landed on PlatformGroupContainer and opened nothing. Positive control: the same posted click opens the zoom menu (zoom-readout-double-click-walk picture). By hand in the probe was not possible: this runner has no Accessibility grant to move the real pointer, and the person was away.

Adversarial review before building: a Premiere or Photoshop user clicks anywhere on a dropdown and expects its menu under it, a tick on the current value, Space or Return when tabbed to it. SwiftUI's button-style Menu makes the face clickable but builds no pop-up button, so every walk that reads or picks from a dropdown without opening it on screen (the focus-safe, lock-safe path) would have lost it. Chose a real AppKit pull-down exactly the face's size with SelectFace hosted inside it, rows as VideoKit.Choice values.

Shipped: VideoKit.Dropdown/DropdownRow/DropdownButton/Choice (VideoKitControls.swift), all 16 call sites converted, timeline Easing uses it too (it had the same 1% overlay: the only other one, found by grepping .opacity(0.0 and Color.clear labels). Open state (accent edge) per comp-fields 05 Select; menu hangs flush from the face at least its width (measured: menu window x=1561 w=153, face x=1561 w=153). Space on a focused dropdown opens it (TimelineKeys monitor leaves Space to a focused DropdownButton).

Proof: every-dropdown-opens-on-a-click-walk (15 caption dropdowns + Speed, Show also by Space and Return), every-title-dropdown-opens-on-a-click-walk (Curve, Fade, Easing), every-clip-dropdown-opens-on-a-click-walk (Hold, Type, Length, Hold on black, sound Curve): each clicked at centre, start, end, a pick made and read back; all ok, no flags. EveryDropdownIsClickedByAWalkTests + NoInvisibleHitTargetTests added. Twelve existing dropdown walks re-run green. Scripts/test.sh 10465/10465.

left rough: hover edge now lives inside the button's hosted face; not watched with a real pointer (walks cannot move it). The system menu's own look (13pt rows, dark) is not the mock's drawn menu; asked in the audit's evaluate rather than filed, since it is a judgement.

Filed: the-caption-words-walk-reaches-the-captions-pane (caption-words-pop-walk fails before and after this change: talk opens in View mode) and find-out-why-a-picture-of-an-open-menu-on-a-vide (open-menu pictures over a video document come back black, also on the pre-change code).
Asked for a sweep (not --now): the dropdown component every video walk touches changed; 15 walks run by hand.
